criteria.name: Reader promise and original value
criteria.evidence: Specific title, authentic problem, and explicit value beyond summary.

criteria.name: Prior knowledge, scaffolding, and mental model
criteria.evidence: Prerequisites, activation prompt, and one durable model.

criteria.name: Technical depth and reproducibility
criteria.evidence: Worked reasoning; 1 code fences; tested environment with versions=True.

criteria.name: Practice, feedback, retrieval, and transfer
criteria.evidence: Practice and self-check; 4 retrieval questions; transfer=True.

criteria.name: Visual explanation and accessibility
criteria.evidence: Real visual, equivalent alt text, caption, descriptive links; 0 oversized paragraphs.

criteria.name: Global editorial clarity
criteria.evidence: Consistent global English, defined terminology, and an estimated 24-minute technical read.

criteria.name: Platform metadata and disclosure
criteria.evidence: Portable metadata, early AI disclosure, and canonical strategy.

criteria.name: Series continuity and next action
criteria.evidence: Previous/index/next navigation, recap, and next-lesson bridge.
